summary: Repaired AI Services post-launch health interruption handling so KeyboardInterrupt and InterruptedError during health verification record a structured interrupted lifecycle, append audit events, return structured JSON, and clear health_pending state.
interruption_behavior: Health-check interruptions are caught at the health-check boundary after process start, converted to result=interrupted with lifecycle_state=interrupted, and recorded in both service and process state.
state_changes: services.<service>.status is set to interrupted instead of remaining health_pending
processes.<service>.health_result includes status=interrupted and the interruption type
preserved_behavior: WP-0133 post-launch health success and failure semantics remain intact
WP-0134 windows_batch command planning and execution behavior remains intact
loopback-only health endpoint policy remains intact
recommended_next_action: Chief Architect review and merge if satisfied with the interruption lifecycle semantics.
